title: 第4章 杀人
content_zh:
在陆宏看来，上官羽只是个普通的小孩子，即使愤怒又如何？难不成上官羽还敢打他不成？就算上官羽要打他，他还能怕了这个小屁孩吗？

“还怎么死的都不知道？我陆宏纵横沙场的时候你还不知道在哪吃奶呢！怎么？难道你想杀了我？”

陆宏越说越起劲，根本没有注意到上官羽的神色。在他想来，上官家家主上官惊鸿不待见上官羽了，上官建城更是想整死上官羽。那么他来教训上官羽，不仅不会挨罚，可能还会得到上官建城的赏赐。

“你肯定不知道吧？当年我纵横沙场，杀了多少英雄豪杰，你这种十二岁的少年，就是几十个也威胁不到我！我骂你杂种你还不乐意了？”

“告诉你，龙生龙，凤生凤，杂种的儿子自然是杂种。今天你要是敢不听话，看我怎么治你！“

上官羽额头青筋直跳，父母是他心中最敬重的人。如今，陆宏不仅辱骂他，更是辱及他父母。是可忍孰不可忍，叔叔可忍婶婶也忍不了。

人不可有傲气，但是不可无傲骨。平时下人欺负下他，顾及上官惊鸿的养育之恩，能忍就忍了。可是现在，陆宏一而再，再而三的辱骂他父母，太过分了。

上官羽一声大吼，“老狗你给我住口，今天谁也救不了你了！”

上官羽仿佛化身了死神，冰冷无情的眼眸盯着陆宏。他往前一冲，犹如流星划破了夜幕。这一瞬间爆发的速度，竟然超越了平时很多。

上官羽这一拳打出了此时的愤怒，仿佛可以摧毁一切敌人。打出了多年的抑郁，心灵得到了极大地升华。

全身的气力都集中到了双拳之中，更是爆发了前所未有的力量。他觉得这一刻甚至可以开天辟地，当然纯属他个人臆想。

拳风扑面，刮得陆宏面颊生痛。这实在不像是一个少年发出的一拳，简直比他自己的拳劲还要大出许多。陆宏行伍出身，反应自是不慢。转身侧开，头颅一偏。

上官羽是腾空飞跃的，否则如何能打到陆宏的头部呢？在陆宏看来，一个小孩子挥出的一拳，你能指望他有多厉害？之所以感觉那么厉害，可能是出现幻觉了吧。不过为了保险起见，他还是闪开了，不硬接更好好。腾空飞跃出拳，只要闪过了，绝对不能快速转向。他相信，等下就是上官羽的死期，杀了上官羽他是不敢，不过打得半残还是可以的。想着想着，脸上竟然还显现出了一丝狞笑。

上官羽那一拳刚好撞上了他的脑袋，就好像是商量好的。那一拳本来打不到他，但是他却把头伸到了拳头那里。

陆宏脸上的狞笑完全消失不见，取而代之的是满脸的不可置信，以及深深地不甘。他不信自己被上官羽这一拳打中了，更不信这一拳会要了他的命。他还有美好的生活要享受呢，只可惜他没那个机会了。

陆宏的头颅碎裂，鲜血狂喷，脑浆四溅，直立的身体也轰然倒塌。没有刀光剑影，只有这一拳，无比可怕的一拳。一个活生生的人，就这么死在了这一拳之下。

“我在做梦吗？你打我一巴掌看看！”

“怎么可能？陆宏竟然被小少爷打死了？”

“不可能的！一个少年怎么可能一拳打死陆宏？”

“陆宏可是行伍出身啊！怎么可能这么不经打？”

下人们议论纷纷，这一幕实在是超出了他们的想象。一些丫鬟更是当场呕吐了起来，身在将军府，又何曾见过这么血腥的场面？

一些下人更是吓得面无血色，这些人都是平时仗着上官建城的势，而欺负上官羽的。谁能想到，那么文弱的少年竟然可以一拳打死行伍出身的陆宏？如果早知道这样，他们无论如何也不敢惹这个小煞星！

那一拳的风采，那一眼的淡漠，那一刻的场景，估计这些下人一辈子都忘不掉了。

上官羽转头，看了这群下人一眼，场中立马安静了下来。他们现在明白了，这位小少爷并不是看起来那么和善，反而是个杀人不眨眼的恶魔。

他没有理会下人们的反应，蹲下身，用陆宏的衣服擦了擦双手。第一次杀人，上官羽也不知道心里是什么感受。他不觉得做错了什么，陆宏辱骂了他的父母，父母可是他心中最敬重的人。如果辱骂他也就算了，可是陆宏如此过分，真是是死不足惜。

“你们去向老爷报告吧！”上官羽淡淡的声音从远处传来，原来上官羽已经走到院子里面了。

“你们吵什么吵？将军府这么嘈杂，成何体统？”

这是一名富态的中年人，穿着一身华丽的长袍，满脸横肉，将军肚，水桶腰。走起路来，脸上的肥肉一抖一抖，看着十分搞笑。不过下人们却不敢笑，因为他是上官府的总管家马文。

马文是上官惊鸿的表弟，靠着上官惊鸿的势力，在飞羽城绝对是个手眼通天的人物。也是个狠角色，得罪他的都没有好下场。

“启禀管家，陆宏和小少爷发生矛盾，然后就被小少爷一拳打死了！”一个看起来特别机灵的下人。抢先走了过来，跪着对马文说道。

“什么？你说什么？你再说一遍！”

马文这次可是真的惊讶了，完全不顾他总管家的身份了。上官府的小少爷，也就是上官羽，如今才十二岁，怎么可能一拳打死行伍出身的陆宏？

上官羽他也认识，平时还是叫着他叔叔的。看起来是个很和善的少年，文质彬彬，谦虚有礼。

就算明知道上官羽不能修炼武道，马文也没有得罪过他，甚至还给了他一些帮助。在马文看来，上官羽有着远超同龄人的意识，更是懂得如何做人，将来必定不是凡人。

上官惊鸿不待见上官羽，上官建城也恨透了上官羽，但马文没有搀和其中。今天的一切都是靠着上官惊鸿的关系得到的，作为一个明白人，他是不会搀和到上官家的家事的。

尽管不欺凌上官羽，尽管认为上官羽将来不凡，但是也接受不了这个事实啊。一个十二岁的少年，并且是不能修炼武道的，一拳打死一个行伍出身的士兵，谁能接受？

那个下人也是机灵，站起身来，弯着腰走到陆宏的尸体旁边。“这就是陆宏的尸体，小少爷一拳打到他的头，爆头而亡。”他也不敢仔细盯着陆宏的尸体看，那突出的一对眼球，看了绝对毛骨悚然。

马文倒是没有异常，杀人放火都做过，看一个死人又有什么呢？

“奴才亲眼看到的，在场的其他人也可以作证！”

马文看向周围的下人，他的心里其实已经相信，只是确认一下而已。

“是啊，奴才们都是亲眼看到的！”

得到每个下人的亲口承认，并且原原本本的了解了事情经过。马文就算心里再如何的惊讶，也只能放在心里了。

“你，就你！”马文指着刚才的那个机灵的下人，“你找几个人帮陆宏的尸体处理好，然后风风光光的下葬了！这件事情处理好，以后就跟在我身边做事了！”

“是，管家！”这个下人顿时眉飞色舞，其他人也是向他投去了羡慕的眼神。

“你们这些人给我记着，今天发生的事情绝不可外传！如果让我发现谁乱嚼舌根子，我定叫他后悔来到这个世上！听清楚了没？”

马文神色俱厉，这件事说大不大，说小不小。刚好上官惊鸿最近回来了，刚好交给上官惊鸿处理。

马文满意地点了点头，转过身，踏步离开了。这件事情得马上禀报给上官惊鸿，否则绝对要出事情。

陆宏可不是一般人，他从小和上官惊鸿一起长大。尽管只是个下人，但是仗着这层身份，也不知道做了多少坏事。没想到今天竟然被上官羽杀死了，直到现在，马文也掩饰不了心中的震撼。

上官羽走进了院子里，来到了池水边。在陆宏衣服上擦拭的双手，并没有清理干净。毕竟是第一次杀人，心里还是有一点阴影的。

上官羽使劲的搓洗着双手，脑子里却想到了上官惊鸿。对于这个曾经又爱又敬的父亲，他也不知道如今该怎么面对。

曾经，上官惊鸿是多么的疼爱他，后来不能修炼武道也觉得十分愧疚。一度想着，一定要修炼出元气，不让上官惊鸿失望。

直到后来，上官羽无意中听到了上官建城与下人的对话。那一刻，他才明白，上官惊鸿对他的爱本来就是假的，只是不知道出于什么原因。但是上官羽心中，还是感激上官惊鸿的，要不然他早就离开了这个毫无温暖的上官家。

上官羽抬头看着万里无云的天空，心里不知道在想些什么。
content_en:
In Lu Hong's view, Shangguan Yu was just an ordinary child, so what if he was angry?Could it be that Shangguan Yu still dared to hit him?Even if Shangguan Yu wants to beat him, can he still be afraid of this little brat?

"Why don't you know why you died? When I, Lu Hongzong, was on the battlefield, you didn't know where to feed me! What? Do you want to kill me?"

Lu Hongyue spoke more and more energetically, not noticing Shangguan Yu's expression at all.When he thought about it, Shangguan Jinghong, the head of the Shangguan family, didn't want to see Shangguan Yu anymore, and Shangguan Jiancheng even wanted to kill Shangguan Yu.Then if he comes to teach Shangguan Yu a lesson, not only will he not be punished, but he may also be rewarded by Shangguan's city building.

"You must not know, right? Back then, I ran across the battlefield and killed so many heroes. Even dozens of twelve-year-old boys like you couldn't threaten me! Are you still not happy when I call you a bastard?"

"Let me tell you, dragons give birth to dragons, and phoenixes give birth to phoenixes. The son of a bastard is naturally a bastard. If you dare to disobey me today, see how I will punish you!"

Veins were pulsing on Shangguan Yu's forehead. His parents were the most respected people in his heart.Now, Lu Hong not only insulted him, but also insulted his parents.It's unbearable. My uncle can tolerate it, but my aunt can't.

People cannot be arrogant, but they cannot be without pride.His subordinates usually bullied him, but considering Shangguan Jinghong's upbringing, he tolerated it as long as he could.But now, Lu Hong insulted his parents again and again, which was too much.

Shangguan Yu yelled, "Old dog, shut up, no one can save you today!"

Shangguan Yu seemed to have transformed into the god of death, staring at Lu Hong with his cold and ruthless eyes.He rushed forward, like a meteor piercing the night.The speed of the explosion at this moment was much faster than usual.

Shangguan Yu's punch showed the anger at this moment, as if it could destroy all enemies.After years of depression, my soul has been greatly sublimated.

All the energy in his body was concentrated into his fists, and he exploded with unprecedented power.He felt that this moment could even open up the world, but of course it was purely his personal imagination.

The wind from the fist hit his face, causing pain on Lu Hong's cheek.This really didn't look like a punch from a young boy. It was simply much more powerful than his own punch.Lu Hongxing was born in the military, so his reaction was not slow.He turned around and tilted his head.

Shangguan Yu was flying in the air, otherwise how could he hit Lu Hong on the head?In Lu Hong's opinion, how powerful can you expect a child to be with a punch?The reason why I feel so powerful is that I may be hallucinating.However, for the sake of safety, he still moved out of the way, it would be better not to force the attack.If you jump in the air and punch, as long as you dodge it, you must not turn quickly.He believed that Shangguan Yu would die soon, and he would not dare to kill Shangguan Yu, but he could still beat him to a semi-crippling state.As he thought about it, a hint of a sinister smile appeared on his face.

Shangguan Yu's punch just hit his head, as if it was planned.That punch couldn't hit him, but he stretched his head to the fist.

The ferocious smile on Lu Hong's face completely disappeared, replaced by a look of disbelief and deep unwillingness.He didn't believe that he was hit by Shangguan Yu's punch, let alone that this punch would kill him.He still has a wonderful life to enjoy, but it's a pity that he doesn't have that chance.

Lu Hong's head shattered, blood spurted out, brains splattered, and his upright body collapsed.There was no flash of sword, only this punch, an extremely terrifying punch.A living person died under this punch.

"Am I dreaming? Just slap me and see!"

"How is it possible? Lu Hong was beaten to death by the young master?"

"Impossible! How could a young man kill Lu Hong with one punch?"

"Lu Hong is from the military! How can he be so inexperienced?"

The servants were talking a lot, this scene was beyond their imagination.Some maids even vomited on the spot. How had they ever seen such a bloody scene in the General's Mansion?

Some servants were so frightened that their faces turned pale. These people usually bullied Shangguan Yu by relying on Shangguan's power in building the city.Who would have thought that such a weak young man could kill Lu Hong, who was born in the military, with one punch?If they had known this earlier, they would not have dared to mess with this little evil star anyway!

The grace of that punch, the indifference of that glance, and the scene at that moment are probably something these servants will never forget.

Shangguan Yu turned his head and glanced at the group of servants, and the crowd immediately became quiet.They now understand that this young master is not as kind as he seems, but is actually a murderous demon.

He ignored people's reactions, squatted down, and wiped his hands with Lu Hong's clothes.Shangguan Yu didn't know how he felt when he killed someone for the first time.He didn't feel that he had done anything wrong. Lu Hong insulted his parents, who were the most respected people in his heart.It would be fine if he insulted him, but Lu Hong went so far that it would be a shame to die.

"Go and report to the master!" Shangguan Yu's faint voice came from a distance. It turned out that Shangguan Yu had already walked into the yard.

"Why are you making such a fuss? The general's palace is so noisy, how can it be decent?"

This is a wealthy middle-aged man, wearing a gorgeous robe, with a fleshy face, a general belly, and a bucket waist.As he walked, the fat on his face trembled, which looked very funny.However, the servants did not dare to laugh because he was Ma Wen, the chief steward of Shangguan Mansion.

Ma Wen is Shangguan Jinghong's cousin. With Shangguan Jinghong's power, he is definitely a man with powerful eyes and hands in Feiyu City.He is also a ruthless character, and no one who offends him will end well.

"Reporting to the housekeeper, Lu Hong had a conflict with the young master, and then he was punched to death by the young master!" A servant who looked particularly smart.He came over first, knelt down and said to Marvin.

"What? What did you say? Say it again!"

Marvin was really surprised this time, completely ignoring his status as the head butler.The young master of Shangguan Mansion, also known as Shangguan Yu, is only twelve years old now. How can he kill Lu Hong, who was born in the army, with one punch?

He also knows Shangguan Yu and usually calls him uncle.He seems to be a very kind young man, well-mannered, humble and polite.

Even though he knew that Shangguan Yu could not practice martial arts, Ma Wen did not offend him and even gave him some help.In Ma Wen's opinion, Shangguan Yu has a consciousness far beyond that of his peers, and he also knows how to be a human being. He will definitely be no ordinary person in the future.

Shangguan Jinghong did not want to see Shangguan Yu, and Shangguan Jiancheng also hated Shangguan Yu, but Ma Wen did not get involved.Everything today was obtained through Shangguan Jinghong's relationship. As a sensible person, he would not interfere with Shangguan's family affairs.

Even though he doesn't bully Shangguan Yu, even though he thinks Shangguan Yu will be extraordinary in the future, he still can't accept this fact.Who can accept that a twelve-year-old boy, who cannot practice martial arts, kills a soldier from the army with one punch?

The servant was also smart. He stood up and bent over and walked to Lu Hong's body."This is Lu Hong's body. The young master punched him in the head and killed him." He didn't dare to look at Lu Hong's body carefully. The protruding eyeballs were absolutely terrifying.

There was nothing unusual about Marvin. He had committed murder and arson. What was the point of looking at a dead person?

"This slave saw it with his own eyes, and others present can also testify!"

Marvin looked at the servants around him. He actually believed it in his heart and was just confirming it.

"Yes, all the slaves saw it with their own eyes!"

It was personally acknowledged by every servant, and they understood exactly what happened.No matter how surprised Marvin was, he could only keep it in his heart.

"You, just you!" Marvin pointed at the clever servant just now, "Find a few people to help Lu Hong's body be disposed of, and then bury it in a glorious manner! Once this matter is handled, you will work with me from now on!"

"Yes, butler!" The servant suddenly beamed with joy, and the others also cast envious looks at him.

"You guys, please remember that what happened today must not be spread to outsiders! If I find anyone gossiping, I will make him regret coming to this world! Do you hear me clearly?"

Marvin looked stern, whether this matter was a big deal or a small matter.It just so happened that Shangguan Jinghong came back recently, and it happened to be handed over to Shangguan Jinghong.

Marvin nodded with satisfaction, turned around, and walked away.This matter must be reported to Shangguan Jinghong immediately, otherwise something will definitely happen.

Lu Hong is not an ordinary person. He grew up with Shangguan Jinghong.Even though he was just a servant, he did many bad things because of his status.Unexpectedly, he was killed by Shangguan Yu today. Even now, Marvin can't hide the shock in his heart.

Shangguan Yu walked into the yard and came to the edge of the pool.The hands he wiped on Lu Hong's clothes were not cleaned.After all, it was my first time to kill someone, so I still had a little shadow in my heart.

Shangguan Yu scrubbed his hands vigorously, but thought of Shangguan Jinghong.He didn't know how to face this father whom he once loved and respected.

Shangguan Jinghong once loved him so much, but later he felt very guilty for not being able to practice martial arts.I once thought that I must cultivate my vitality and not let Shangguan Jinghong be disappointed.

Until later, Shangguan Yu overheard the conversation between Shangguan Jiancheng and his servants.At that moment, he realized that Shangguan Jinghong's love for him was fake, but he didn't know why.But in Shangguan Yu's heart, he was still grateful to Shangguan Jinghong, otherwise he would have left this unwarm Shangguan family long ago.

Shangguan Yu looked up at the cloudless sky, wondering what he was thinking.
